name: rm2
description: List, view and upload documents on a reMarkable 2 over its USB cable, with optional Wi-Fi

ssh_host.title: SSH host for Wi-Fi (optional)
ssh_host.description: Leave empty to connect over the USB cable only. Set to an SSH host with key login to the tablet (for example rm2 from ~/.ssh/config) to fall back to Wi-Fi when the cable is not connected.
